steps.explanation: Passing notes are added after 5 melody notes (C5 after B4, B4 after C5, D4 after C4, F4 after E4, …), in the second half of each; every main note keeps its pitch and onset. 5 notes are added. The pitch sequence is unchanged. 5 of 27 notes change length. Every note starts where it did. Unchanged: bass pitches.

operations.name: Melodic sequence

operations.name: Bass pattern

operations.disabledReason: Reharmonise changes the chords under the melody, so it is off while Keep bass is on.
